hooks.command: f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); if [ -n "$f" ] && [[ "$f" != "/Users/kuramochikeito/Desktop/hobby/sensor"/* ]] && [ "$f" != "/Users/kuramochikeito/Desktop/hobby/sensor" ]; then jq -n "{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:\"PreToolUse\",permissionDecision:\"deny\",permissionDecisionReason:\"File operations outside the project folder /Users/kuramochikeito/Desktop/hobby/sensor are not allowed.\"}}"; fi

f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); if [ -n "$f" ]; then b=$(basename "$f"); if echo "$b" | grep -Eiq "^\.env(\..*)?$|credentials|secrets?\.(json|ya?ml|txt)$|\.pem$|\.key$|\.p12$|\.pfx$|^id_rsa|^id_ed25519|\.keystore$|^\.netrc$"; then jq -n "{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:\"PreToolUse\",permissionDecision:\"deny\",permissionDecisionReason:\"Access to environment or secret files (.env, credentials, keys, etc.) is blocked by project policy. Never read or reference these files.\"}}"; fi; fi

mkdir -p .claude/.session_markers; sid=$(jq -r ".session_id // \"unknown\""); date +%s > ".claude/.session_markers/$sid"; jq -n "{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:\"SessionStart\",additionalContext:\"SESSION LOGGING RULE (see CLAUDE.md): This project keeps a shared progress log at SESSION_LOG.md so any session, on any machine, can see what is currently being worked on. At the start of this session, read SESSION_LOG.md to catch up on prior context. Before this session ends, add a new dated entry near the top of the Entries section (do not delete prior entries) in the format: ## YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM - short title, followed by bullet points covering what was done, current status, and next steps. Keep entries concise.\"}}"

sid=$(jq -r ".session_id // \"unknown\""); marker=".claude/.session_markers/$sid"; if [ -f "$marker" ]; then start_ts=$(cat "$marker"); log_mtime=$(stat -f %m SESSION_LOG.md 2>/dev/null || echo 0); if [ "$log_mtime" -le "$start_ts" ]; then jq -n "{decision:\"block\",reason:\"SESSION_LOG.md has not been updated yet in this session. Append a dated entry (what was done / current status / next steps) to SESSION_LOG.md before finishing, per the project rule in CLAUDE.md.\"}"; fi; fi
